summary: Shoppers on wider screens see cute doomsday story cards in the header that cycle and open a story page recommending the products that help in that scenario.

acceptanceCriteria.original: Scenario's need to be kawaii, but they do not have to be accurate.
acceptanceCriteria.refined: Every story is written in the shop's cute, tongue-in-cheek anime tone; factual accuracy is not required.

risk.rationale: Tone only; no effect on buying.

testApproach.reason: Subjective content quality; reviewed during exploratory session S2.

acceptanceCriteria.refined: Each story page shows between 1 and 3 paragraphs of story text.

testApproach.reason: Static content with no input; counted once during exploratory session S2.

acceptanceCriteria.original: Scenariocards are visible on each viewport that has plenty of room between the logo and the basket. Show either 0, 1, 3 or 5 depending on available space.
acceptanceCriteria.refined: The header shows 0 story cards below 720px wide, 1 from 720px, 3 from 1024px and 5 from 1440px, without overlapping the logo or the basket link.

risk.rationale: New responsive logic in the shared header; overlap would hide the basket link on every page.

acceptanceCriteria.original: If less than 5 scenariocards are shown, make sure they cycle every 10 seconds.
acceptanceCriteria.refined: When fewer than 5 cards are visible, the cards advance by one story every 10 seconds; with 5 cards visible nothing moves. A pause button stops cycling, and cycling pauses while a card is hovered or focused.

risk.rationale: Timer and state logic; failure is confusing and an accessibility issue.

acceptanceCriteria.original: When you click a story card, a story page is shown. That page is centerered around a scenario.
acceptanceCriteria.refined: Activating a story card (click or Enter) opens that story's page, whose main heading is the story title.

risk.rationale: Navigation from every page; a wrong or broken link is a dead end.

acceptanceCriteria.original: Create 5 scenario's that are loosely based on popular belief, lore or legend. Incorporate the 3 products in a way so that each of the products would be beneficial for at least 1 of the scenario's.
acceptanceCriteria.refined: There are exactly 5 stories based on lore or legend; every product (Dehydrated Water, Tinfoil Thinking Cap, Canned Optimism) is recommended with a link on at least one story page.

risk.rationale: Links to product pages can break; drives sales from stories.

decisions.evidence: Ticket text numbers two criteria as 5.

decisions.decision: Same cute anime, tongue-in-cheek tone as the existing shop copy.
decisions.evidence: README.md 'anime-themed'; index.html title 'Kawaii Doomsday Supplies'; copilot-instructions tone rule.
Asked: 'AC3: at which screen widths should 0, 1, 3 and 5 story cards be shown in the header?'

decisions.decision: Advance by one story every 10 seconds.
decisions.evidence: Asked: 'AC4: when fewer than 5 cards are visible, what should change every 10 seconds?'

decisions.decision: Visible pause/play button; cycling also pauses while a card is hovered or has focus.
decisions.evidence: WCAG 2.2.2 Pause, Stop, Hide; copilot-instructions accessibility rule.

decisions.decision: No slide animation when prefers-reduced-motion is set; cards still change.
Story title and a one-line teaser; the whole card is one link.
decisions.evidence: Limited header space; HTML semantics for navigation.

decisions.decision: One static page per story (story-<slug>.html) using the product page skeleton.
decisions.evidence: Static site without build step; strict CSP (copilot-instructions).

decisions.decision: Story title as h1, story text, then links to the products that help.
decisions.evidence: AC6 requires products to be beneficial; product pages exist.

decisions.decision: Ragnarök, The Kraken's Bath Day, The Mind-Ray Mothership, The Great Calendar Reset, The Moon Catches a Cold.
decisions.evidence: Creative content without behavioural impact, constrained by AC1, AC2 and AC6.

decisions.decision: Cards appear in the header on every page.
decisions.evidence: All pages share the same site-header markup.

outOfScope: Story cards on screens narrower than 720px
Changes to products, basket or checkout
